# Raghav Puppala

> Financial advisor in Hyderabad, India. MDRT-qualified, IRDAI-licensed and an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor, with 15+ years of experience and 500+ families guided. Helps families protect, build and grow wealth with clarity and confidence. Indian Air Force veteran.

Website: https://raghavpuppala.com

## What he offers
- Investments: mutual funds, stocks, IPOs, bonds and savings plans, matched to goals and time horizon. SIPs set up and reviewed with the client.
- Insurance: life, health and motor cover sized to what the family needs.
- Retirement and goals: pension plans, child education funds and a retirement corpus.
- Financial fitness session: a free, no-obligation 30-minute online session covering risk evaluation (life, health and income protection), goal planning (education, retirement and dreams) and wealth creation (systematic, disciplined growth).
